summary: pin tombstone reconciliation delay causes transparent routing to degraded variant during canary drain
description:
Issue summary:
During a canary drain we observed that tenant pin tombstones created by a previous rollback were not reconciled by the edge reconciler for ~4 minutes. As a result the tenant was routed transparently to a degraded variant (fallback) despite an explicit model pin in the control plane.

Impact:
- Customer (NimbleDocs) traffic experienced ~6% error-rate increase and quality regressions for ~5 minutes on prod-us-east.
- Affected requests were silently served by the degraded variant; no 5xx surfaced, so the application only noticed quality drop and higher token cost.

Environment:
- Redwood Hosted (dedicated pool) in prod-us-east
- Customer tenant: nimbledocs-prod
- Canary workflow: rolling-drain from canary-2026-03-10-01 -> primary-2026-03-10-01

Steps to reproduce (internal):
1) Create a tenant pin to model redwood/open-llama-7b-v2 and confirm edge cache shows pinned variant.
2) Simulate canary drain by triggering preemptive drain on a canary shard (drain window 01:12).
3) Immediately perform a rollback that leaves a tombstone entry on the orchestrator snapshot.
4) Observe edge reconciler logs and routing table for tenant during next 10 minutes.

Observed behavior:
- Orchestrator snapshot contains a tombstone record for tenant pin with ttl=300s (log: orchestrator/commit id 7f2a).
- Edge reconciler ignores tombstone until a full snapshot refresh (happens on schedule every 5m) -> reconciliation delay ~240s.
- During the delay, routing decision used fallback route to degraded variant due to tombstone taking precedence at edge lookup.

Expected behavior:
- Tombstone should be applied centrally and the edge reconciler should treat a tombstone that matches an explicit control-plane pin as a no-op (or surface a conflict) to avoid silent fallback.

Relevant logs/snippets:
- orchestrator commit: https://logs.redwood/team/orchestrator/commit/7f2a (entries: "pin:tombstone:create tenant=nimbledocs-prod ttl=300")
- edge reconciler trace: "reconcile: snapshot-mismatch -> tombstone-preserved until refresh"
- router decisions: route-lookup tenant=nimbledocs-prod -> variant=degraded-v1 (fallback)

Mitigation taken so far:
- Support performed an immediate edge sidecar cache flush for the affected shard (manual flush) which restored correct routing within ~30s.
- Escalated to SRE for a short-term config change to reduce snapshot refresh interval from 5m -> 1m for canary shards (pilot).

Workaround for customer:
- If a rollback + tombstone occurs during a canary drain, request the customer to trigger a sidecar cache flush via support tool or wait for scheduled snapshot refresh (~5m).

Next steps / action items:
- [P0] Add a tombstone reconciliation rule: control-plane-explicit-pins should override tombstone application on edge unless explicit delete is requested (owner: Diego).
- Instrument additional metrics for tombstone apply latency in edge reconciler.
- Backfill a hotfix to trigger on-demand reconciler refresh when a tombstone accompanies a drain/rollback event (PR referenced below).

Customer-facing summary (to send to NimbleDocs):
We investigated a short routing regression during your canary window caused by a delayed reconciliation of a tombstone record at the edge. We applied a cache flush to restore correct routing and are deploying a fix to ensure tombstones don’t cause silent fallbacks for pinned tenants. We will follow up with timeline for a permanent fix and a post-incident note.

investigation_notes: Edge reconciler relies on periodic snapshot refresh; incremental tombstone events are currently persisted but not pushed to edge peers in real-time.
Tombstone TTL is set at 300s by default; orchestrator creates tombstone on rollback to prevent immediate re-promotion but didn't signal edges to treat it as transient for pinned tenants.
Hypothesis: preemptive drain + immediate rollback creates a short-lived tombstone that the edge treats as higher precedence during lookup because of ordering in the reconciler's local store.
Reproducer script captured exact timing and confirms reconciler skip window aligned with schedule jitter of snapshot refresh (±10s).
resolution: Partial mitigation applied (manual cache flush + reduced snapshot interval for pilot). Hotfix PR opened to trigger on-demand reconciler refresh and to add an override rule for explicit pins vs tombstones. Waiting on product decision for policy. Target full fix deploy in next canary on 2026-03-14.
